Pointer — director seat, summon #46, `session_013414Vtz3Z8PrXFetUziHoh`, 2026-10-20T10:24Z. ⛔ Not a claim; not a grade.

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24762 was ruled **E** (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24762 comment 6288774214, maintainer 「同意」): its server half (B1) goes to the services lane there, and its console half is **this card** (C). The ruling's item 6 binds this card's shape: on an impersonation session (`session.impersonatedBy` set), the remediation overlay offers "Stop impersonating", and it no longer offers the target's change-password or MFA-enrolment forms to the impersonator. Under E the overlay still appears on an impersonation session for `MFA_REQUIRED` (account scope) and for any posture that arrives mid-session. This card does not wait on B1 and B1 does not wait on it. Triage's first touch (`domain:*`, `area:*`, grade) is still owed; the objectstack console pin bump follows its landing.

The stop logic of `packages/app-shell/src/layout/ImpersonationBanner.tsx` is shared, not copied (a helper inside `app-shell`, not added to the package entry). New copy in the locale packs the parity gates require. Tests beside both. One `.changeset/13208-overlay-stop-impersonating.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`, plus `@object-ui/i18n` if a pack moves). ⛔ No server change. ⛔ No new package export or prop. ⛔ The overlay still appears on an impersonation session for any posture the server reports (the server half, B1, is the objectstack services lane's). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: the risk is produced by objectui's own `RemediationOverlay`, which covers the impersonation banner (`fixed inset-0 z-[200]` over the banner's `sticky z-50`) and never reads `session.impersonatedBy`, so an impersonating admin is offered the target's credential forms and can only sign out. The platform path that covers it: the server exit `/admin/stop-impersonating` is deliberately unheld, and the banner already calls it; only the overlay hides it. Who reaches it: every admin who impersonates a user held by a posture (measured: a user with "Require password change on next login").
Thread-read: 6288799348
The ruling binds the shape: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24762 comment 6288774214 (maintainer 「同意」, letter E), item 6: 「On an impersonation session the overlay offers "Stop impersonating", and it no longer offers the target's remediation forms to the impersonator.」
Serial constraints cleared: open objectui PRs touching `RemediationOverlay.tsx`, `ImpersonationBanner.tsx` or `ConsoleShell.tsx`: none (the eleven open PRs' file lists were read at this claim). The ruling says this card does not wait on B1.

Why `Clause-②: no`: a console overlay offers an exit the console already has. No export, prop, schema key or accept set of a published package moves.

Claimed at: 2026-10-20T11:15Z
